definitions.de: Antworten; eine Reaktion oder Erwiderung auf eine Frage, Nachricht oder Anfrage geben.
definitions.en: To answer or reply; to respond to a question, message, or request.
definitions.es: Responder; dar una respuesta a una pregunta, mensaje o solicitud.
definitions.fr: Répondre; donner une réponse à une question, un message ou une demande.
definitions.hi: उत्तर देना; किसी प्रश्न, संदेश या अनुरोध का जवाब देना।
definitions.ja: 答える、返答する；質問・メッセージ・要求に対して反応する。
definitions.km: ឆ្លើយ; ផ្តល់ចម្លើយដល់សំណួរ សារ ឬសំណើ។
definitions.ko: 대답하다, 답장하다; 질문, 메시지 또는 요청에 응하다.
definitions.ne: जवाफ दिनु; कुनै प्रश्न, सन्देश वा अनुरोधको उत्तर दिनु।
definitions.pt: Responder; dar uma resposta a uma pergunta, mensagem ou pedido.
definitions.th: ตอบ; ให้คำตอบหรือโต้ตอบต่อคำถาม ข้อความ หรือคำขอ
definitions.tl: Sumagot o tumugon; magbigay ng sagot sa isang tanong, mensahe, o kahilingan.
definitions.ur: جواب دینا؛ کسی سوال، پیغام یا درخواست کا جواب دینا۔
definitions.vi: Trả lời; đưa ra phản hồi cho một câu hỏi, tin nhắn hoặc yêu cầu.
definitions.zh: 回答；对问题、消息或请求作出回应。
definitions.zh_Hant: 回答；對問題、訊息或請求作出回應。

definition_en: To answer or reply; to respond to a question, message, or request.

lao_examples.romanization: pen nyang jao boo tɔ̀ːp thoo-la-sap dèː?
lao_examples.translation_en: Why didn't you answer the phone?

lao_examples.lao_script: ຕອບຂ້ອຍຖ້າເຈົ້າຮູ້ຄຳຕອບ
lao_examples.romanization: tɔ̀ːp khoi thaa jao huu kham tɔ̀ːp
lao_examples.translation_en: Answer me if you know the answer.
